moncab.description: From small fixes to full-stack features across the entire codebase. Built the invitation system, v2 search algorithm (weighted scoring, 6 factors), Pennylane billing integration (invoicing, dynamic VAT, webhooks), Ubiflow listing syndication, optimistic messaging updates, owner dashboard with payment stats, and multiple Stripe endpoint security passes. 113+ commits in ~2 months.

leairn.title: leAIrn
leairn.description: A gamified learning platform for mastering AI prompting — like Duolingo, but for prompts. Features 6 exercise types, AI-powered evaluation via Groq, full gamification (XP, streaks, badges, leaderboard), social features, and Stripe-based freemium/pro subscriptions.

nali.title: Nali
nali.description: A modern SaaS alternative to Jira/Linear, built for dev teams. Includes multi-org management, Kanban boards with sprints, real-time messaging, AES-256 encrypted documents, GitHub integration, WebRTC video calls, and Stripe billing with 4 plans.

reflexion.title: scraping-polymarket
reflexion.description: An autonomous predictive trading bot that scrapes multi-source data (Polymarket, Google News, Reddit, CoinGecko), analyzes prediction markets via a local LLM (Qwen 2.5 7B) using a superforecaster methodology, and generates calibrated predictions with paper trading.

minishell.title: Minishell
minishell.description: Unix command interpreter in C — execution, redirections, pipes, environment variables and signal handling.

irc.title: IRC
irc.description: IRC server in C++ with non-blocking TCP sockets — multi-client handling, authentication, channels and real-time messaging.

transcendence.title: Transcendence
transcendence.description: Full-stack web app — real-time multiplayer Pong via WebSockets, auth, chat, stats and match history.

music_room.title: Music_Room
music_room.description: Mobile music sharing app — collaborative playlists, events, voting and personalized profiles with React Native and Node.js.

matcha.title: Matcha
matcha.description: Matcha is a social dating application. It allows users to create profiles, browse other profiles, send messages, and find matches based on shared interests. The application incorporates features such as geolocation, user preferences, and a real-time notification system. The project implements a full-stack architecture with a backend API, a database for user management, and an interactive frontend for an engaging user experience.

linear_regression.description: Machine learning project implementing linear regression from scratch for price prediction.
